models.name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
models.description: Fast and accurate multilingual recognizer (recommended).

models.name: Whisper large-v3
models.description: Most accurate, slower than turbo.

models.name: Whisper small
models.description: For weak GPUs / CPU.

models.name: Russian SOFA hhskt_ru v0.0.1
models.author: m & HHS_kt
models.description: Russian singing aligner trained by m and hhs_kt (the model is named after hhs_kt). Data: hhs_kt, XHR0ME, Miya, m, Gitreti, about 4 hours. Modified cmusphinx-ru-5.2 dictionary and a G2P by m for unknown words. When you label with it, please link the model page or the hhs_kt channel (t.me/hhs_kt_666).

models.name: SOFA model pack v030 (English, French, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean)
models.description: English, French, Mandarin, Japanese and Korean SOFA models with G2P: tgm v0.0.5 (tigermeat), millefeuille b001 (imsupposedto), suco (SOFA v1.0.1), colstone Japanese v0.0.2b and Korean v0.0.1b. Downloading the pack registers every model inside as sofa-pack-<folder>.
models.author: tigermeat and contributors

models.name: English SOFA tgm v1.0.0
models.author: tigermeat
models.description: Newer English model than the v0.0.5 in the v030 pack (other weights, same dictionary and G2P); trained only on data labelled or checked by hand by its author.

models.name: Japanese SOFA akm_ja v0.0.1
models.author: ariikamusic
models.description: Japanese singing aligner trained on hand-annotated data (the author's own and community datasets). May misplace phonemes on noisy audio and put stray AP/SP into long silence.

models.name: Japanese SOFA Test2_Plus
models.author: Greenleaf2001
models.description: Japanese singing aligner (japanese-extension dictionary, romaji preferred), a smaller and faster model than Test2.

models.name: Mandarin SOFA v2.1
models.author: BaiShuo
models.description: Mandarin singing aligner with the opencpop-extension dictionary, trained on open and community datasets.

models.name: Mandarin SOFA ACV beta 0.0.1
models.author: Archivoice
models.description: Mandarin singing aligner with ACV-style phonemes (dict_cn.txt), hand-labelled ACV-001 and part of OpenCPop. Beta: little data diversity. The archive is RAR: 7-Zip or the tar of Windows 10/11 unpacks it.

models.name: Cantonese SOFA v0.1
models.author: RibosomeK
models.description: Cantonese singing aligner; jyutping dictionary with an arpabet-like phoneme scheme.

models.name: Cantonese SOFA 250816
models.author: AzairoNS
models.description: Cantonese singing aligner; jyutping dictionary.

models.name: HubertFA v0.0.7 (Mandarin, Japanese, English)
models.description: Multilingual singing aligner (dictionaries: ds-zh-pinyin-lite, japanese_dict_full romaji, ds_cmudict-07b); detects breaths (AP) and other non-lexical sounds (EP).
models.author: wolfgitpr

models.name: TIFA 1.0-ST (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, English)
models.description: Speech and singing aligner by OpenVPI. Languages can be mixed in one text; when a word can be read in several ways it picks the reading heard in the audio; gives self-check scores so badly aligned files can be found without listening to everything. Phonemes: DiffSinger sets (ds-zh-pinyin-lite, jyutping, Japanese romaji, ds_cmudict-07b).
models.author: OpenVPI

models.name: TIFA Russian hhskt_ru v0.0.1
models.author: m & HHS_kt
models.description: Russian singing aligner (TIFA by OpenVPI) trained by m and hhs_kt on about 10 hours of Russian singing; also post-trained on long sequences, so whole songs align as well as phrases. Same 51-phoneme set as the Russian SOFA and WFL-ASR models (modified cmusphinx-ru-5.2 dictionary, 534k words). Works best with optional breaths on. When you label with it, please link the model page or the hhs_kt channel (t.me/hhs_kt_666).

models.name: WFL-ASR Russian hhskt_ru small v0.0.1
models.author: m & HHS_kt
models.description: Phoneme recognition without text for Russian singing, trained by m and HHS_kt (named after HHS_kt). Data: HHS_kt, XHR0ME, Miya, m, Gitreti, about 4 hours. Same phoneme set as the Russian SOFA model. When you label with it, please link the model page or the HHS_kt channel (t.me/hhs_kt_666).

models.name: WFL-ASR fine-tuned (English, Japanese)
models.description: Phoneme recognition without text (Whisper-base encoder). The release's model_1.0.zip needs older WFL-ASR code and is not used.

models.name: GAME large
models.description: Best quality note extraction (~100M parameters).

models.name: GAME small
models.description: Fast, ~12M parameters.

models.name: Vocals / instrumental: BS-Roformer (ViperX 1297)
models.description: High quality vocal extraction from a full mix.

models.name: Vocals / instrumental: MDX-Net Voc FT (fast)
models.description: Lighter vocal extraction, several times faster without an NVIDIA GPU; a little less clean than the Roformers.

models.name: Vocals / instrumental: MelBand Roformer (Kim)
models.description: Vocal extraction, often cleaner on singing.

models.name: Lead / backing vocals: MelBand Roformer karaoke
models.description: Separates the lead vocal from backing vocals (run on already extracted vocals).

models.name: De-reverb / de-echo (UVR VR)
models.description: Removes reverb and echo from vocals.

models.name: PC-NSF-HiFiGAN 44.1 kHz (2025.02)
models.author: OpenVPI
models.description: The vocoder of DiffSinger models, with pitch shifting that keeps the formants. Used to hear a recording with an edited f0. Weights by the OpenVPI team under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: free for non-commercial use with credit; results can't be used commercially. Downloaded from the official release on first use; the NOTICE and STATEMENTS files of the release are kept in the model folder.

models.name: RMVPE
models.description: Robust f0 for singing, also on noisy or accompanied audio.

models.name: FCPE
models.description: Fast f0 estimation (model included in the engine).

models.name: Parselmouth (Praat)
models.description: Classic autocorrelation f0, CPU only, best on clean speech-like audio.

datasets.name: ACV-001
datasets.author: YiChen Huang (Archivoice)
datasets.description: One male singer in six languages. About 3/5 of the labels are manual, the rest WFL-ASR output corrected by hand. The English slur cuts are fixed by the patch (in patch/).

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0
license.summary: Any use with credit. A model that mainly features this voice must be shared under CC BY-SA; models where it is supplementary data (trained together with other voices) can have their own license.

datasets.name: Children's Song Dataset (CSD)
datasets.author: Choi et al. (KAIST)
datasets.description: One female professional singer, 50 Korean and 50 English children's songs, each in two keys. MIDI and lyrics, but no phoneme timing: needs alignment first.
datasets.citation: Choi et al., Children's Song Dataset for Singing Voice Research, ISMIR 2020. doi:10.5281/zenodo.4916302

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
license.summary: Non-commercial use with credit (cite the paper); derived works under the same license; no use that defames the singer.
license.attribution: Children's Song Dataset (Choi et al., ISMIR 2020)

datasets.name: Alex Floarea 2.0 English corpus
datasets.author: NeoDIVA
datasets.description: English singing of the Alex Floarea voicebank. The voice itself must not become public: a model trained with it may not publish its embedding (fine for multi-speaker training of other voices and for labelling models).

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0 + terms
license.summary: Free for non-commercial projects with credit to NeoDIVA. Resulting embeddings (the Alex Floarea voice in a model) must not be public. Licensing fees apply for exceptions.

datasets.name: Project AI♥dol Public English Dataset
datasets.author: Lotte V
datasets.description: English singing (non-native, non-professional female singer), meant for training together with other voices. Extended ARPABET labels (ax, dx, en, EP, GS, vf).

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0 + terms
license.summary: Commercial use allowed with credit; derived works under the same license. A model featuring this voice may not be released without the author's permission (training together with other voices is the intended use). No voice changers (RVC and the like), no use by religious organisations.

datasets.name: PJS corpus
datasets.author: Koguchi, Takamichi (University of Tokyo)
datasets.description: Japanese: 100 short songs and 100 spoken sentences by one male singer, with MIDI and MusicXML. Hand-made phoneme labels by UtaUtaUtau are a separate download (github.com/UtaUtaUtau/pjs-manual-labels, CC BY-SA 4.0). Google Drive: download the zip from the corpus page.
datasets.citation: Koguchi, Takamichi. PJS: phoneme-balanced Japanese singing-voice corpus. arXiv:2006.02959

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0
license.summary: Commercial and non-commercial use with credit; derived works under the same license.
license.attribution: PJS corpus (Koguchi, Takamichi); manual labels by UtaUtaUtau

datasets.name: NIT SONG070 F001 (relabelled)
datasets.author: Nagoya Institute of Technology; relabel by agentasteriski
datasets.description: Japanese: 31 songs by one female singer from the HTS demo, relabelled for DiffSinger (q and EP added).

license.name: CC BY 3.0
license.summary: Any use, including commercial, with credit.
license.attribution: NIT SONG070 F001 © 2004-2015 Nagoya Institute of Technology

datasets.name: Ofuton P UTAGOE DB
datasets.author: おふとんP
datasets.description: Japanese: 46 public-domain songs by one male singer, with MIDI, MusicXML and UST. For personal non-commercial training; publishing a model made from it needs the author's permission.

license.name: Ofuton P terms of use
license.summary: Credit required. Ask the author before commercial use, use by a company, or distributing a voice model or voice library made from the DB. The audio may not be redistributed (labels, MIDI and MusicXML may). Downloading means agreeing to the terms.

datasets.name: Open Greek Singing Dataset (OGSD)
datasets.author: A-MAIN
datasets.description: Greek: one male amateur singer, labels in two phoneme sets (X-SAMPA-like and Sphinx-like).

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 + terms
license.summary: Non-commercial use with credit; multi-speaker training of singing synthesis models and research allowed. Not for RVC/SVC models, not together with celebrity or unauthorised data. Share-alike applies to models mainly featuring this voice.
